landmarks.name: Lalibela Rock-Hewn Churches
landmarks.writeup: A group of 11 medieval monolithic churches carved out of rock, considered a pilgrimage site and a UNESCO World Heritage site.

landmarks.name: Simien Mountains National Park
landmarks.writeup: Known for dramatic mountain scenery and endemic wildlife including the Ethiopian wolf and Gelada baboon.

landmarks.name: Aksum Obelisks
landmarks.writeup: Ancient stelae marking the ruins of the Kingdom of Aksum, an important center of early Christianity.

landmarks.name: The Blue Nile Falls
landmarks.writeup: A spectacular waterfall on the Blue Nile river, locally known as 'Tis Issat' meaning 'smoking water.'

cultural_events.name: Timkat
cultural_events.writeup: Ethiopian Orthodox celebration of Epiphany, featuring colorful processions and religious ceremonies.

cultural_events.name: Meskel
cultural_events.writeup: Festival commemorating the discovery of the True Cross, marked by bonfires and community gatherings.

cultural_events.name: Enkutatash
cultural_events.writeup: Ethiopian New Year celebrated with music, dancing, and gift-giving in September.

food_writeup: Ethiopian cuisine is known for injera, a sourdough flatbread, served with various spicy stews called wats, often featuring lentils, beef, chicken, or vegetables, reflecting the country's rich agricultural heritage and religious fasting traditions.
brief_history: Ethiopia is one of the oldest nations in the world, with human habitation dating back millions of years. It was home to the ancient Kingdom of Aksum and is notable for resisting colonization, maintaining independence except for a brief Italian occupation. It is the origin of coffee and has a unique Christian tradition dating back to the 4th century.

important_people.name: Haile Selassie
important_people.description: Former Emperor and key figure in Ethiopian and African history.

important_people.name: Lucy (Australopithecus afarensis)
important_people.description: Famous early hominid fossil discovered in Ethiopia.

important_people.name: Meles Zenawi
important_people.description: Former Prime Minister who led Ethiopia's economic reforms.

important_people.name: Tewodros II
important_people.description: Emperor known for efforts to modernize Ethiopia.

current_conflicts: Ethiopia has experienced internal conflicts, notably the Tigray conflict beginning in 2020 involving the federal government and the Tigray People's Liberation Front, leading to humanitarian concerns and regional instability.
